02 / MIGRATION MOTION

Choose the shape of the move

Splunk documents three common approaches. The right one depends on historical-data requirements, outage tolerance, parallel-run cost, and the amount of production-load validation needed.

Make this decision with your Splunk account team or delivery partner after discovery; the explorer does not collect enough environment detail to prescribe one.
